architecture.protected_route_rule: MAJOR_PROTECTED and MAJOR_DELEGABLE are sibling implementations. Protected authority is an explicit composed gate policy and is not inherited from delegable behavior.

automation_execution_contract.worker_prompt_scope: Lane prompts may define role-specific work only and must not redefine route/state/gate semantics.
automation_execution_contract.event_and_context_scope: Event fingerprints, context reuse and materiality select work/context only; they never redefine GardenProcess route or authority semantics.
automation_execution_contract.delta_first_rule: Reuse fresh validated context and process changed observations plus affected dependency closure by default; expand when required closure cannot be bounded.
automation_execution_contract.full_context_fallback_rule: Whole-source or wider context remains mandatory when closure is incomplete, DesignEpoch/source root changes, high-risk semantics cross owners, affected contracts/invariants are uncertain, or an assurance rule explicitly requires it.
automation_execution_contract.frontier_chatgpt_rule: External ChatGPT frontier review consumes GardenFrontierReviewRequest/v1 only after materiality. It is not an OpenRouter provider route and cannot self-admit semantic deltas or authority.
automation_execution_contract.blind_review_rule: Individual blind-review workers persist reviewer evidence but cannot alone advance BLIND_REVIEW_COMPLETE; completed results on an unchanged packet hash are reusable.
automation_execution_contract.audit_rule: Independent audit lanes may inspect engine state/receipts but cannot certify their own health or mint authority.

process_algebra_binding.authorization_boundary: Algebra validation never grants authority, admits a semantic delta, or promotes canon.

required_properties: all six routes resolve to concrete process implementations
protected promotion requires external HUMAN protected decision evidence
MAJOR promotion readiness requires verified simplification and enforcement coverage
the sole active Garden coordinator has no recurring clock schedule
due intervals are freshness constraints rather than pollers
event/context optimization cannot bypass required whole-source closure
frontier ChatGPT handoff is distinct from OpenRouter/provider routing
pre-process discovery and external research tasks do not fabricate GardenProcess state
